reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: The read_error exported lbool owns the current read-error indication, initially false and set when iread returns a negative hard error.
owner_creation.invariant: Read status contains no buffer allocation owner.
limitations: read_error records an input failure but does not own its descriptor.

aliases_escapes.analysis: edit.rs:1155 and command.rs:1358 clear the copied status for new operations; no returned pointer ties read_error to the exact read request or ifile.
aliases_escapes.invariant: A global error bit does not brand its input owner.
limitations: Another file activation can reset the status independently of a saved reader.

callback_targets.analysis: The read_error flag is set after the direct iread call; native I/O error/cause handling belongs to that call and its callers, not a callback stored here.
callback_targets.invariant: Error status does not retain the I/O callback context.
limitations: The diagnostic path is direct; the scalar supplies no recovery callback.

invalidation.analysis: Switching files or clearing the read_error bit can discard the earlier indication while cached bytes remain separately owned; callers must consume it at the right boundary.
invalidation.invariant: Resetting status is distinct from retiring input state.

mutation_commit.analysis: ch_get sets read_error before returning -1 without publishing new bytes; error, EOF and interruption still require caller-side interpretation of other state.
mutation_commit.invariant: Failed reads must not commit a new initialized-byte count.

release_pair.analysis: read_error owns status only; a failed read leaves the preexisting filestate and FD for their normal owner cleanup paths.
release_pair.invariant: Read failure alone does not transfer FD ownership.
limitations: Resetting read_error is not a descriptor close or filestate disposal.

error_cleanup.analysis: On a hard iread error, ch_get sets read_error and returns -1 before committing fpos/datasize. Existing cache and FD owners remain live for ch_close or permanent disposal; M0-IO-001 remains open.
error_cleanup.invariant: Error-bit presence cannot substitute for read failure evidence.

signals_handoff.analysis: The read_error flag is non-atomic global metadata, without per-operation identity or exclusion against handler-driven owner changes.
signals_handoff.invariant: Raw read status remains a coupled state hazard.
limitations: M0-IO-001 remains linked and open; current diagnostic improvements are not described as a still-reproduced silent failure.

src/edit.rs.relationship: File activation clears read_error at src/edit.rs:1149-1160, so a read-status snapshot belongs to the selected input lifecycle rather than permanent error ownership.

src/command.rs.relationship: prompt_message tests, reports and clears read_error at src/command.rs:1352-1365. That consumer can erase the status after displaying the per-input diagnostic.
